name: dhamma-echo
description: A quiet desktop library for Dhamma talks.

scripts.format: bun run format:web && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.site:verify: bun run site:test && bun run site:coverage && bun run site:smoke
scripts.verify:web: bun run test:policy && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test:coverage && bun run build:web && bun run smoke:web && bun run icons:check
scripts.verify: bun run format:check && bun run verify:web && bun run site:verify && bun audit --audit-level=high && cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-features && cargo build --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --release
scripts.ci: bun run format:web:check && bun run test:policy && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test:coverage && bun run build:web && bun run smoke:web && bun run icons:check && bun audit --audit-level=high
